label: lf-diagnostic
command: const fs=require('node:fs');const crypto=require('node:crypto');const assert=require('node:assert/strict');const {execFileSync}=require('node:child_process');const hash=b=>crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');const snapshot=fs.readFileSync('learning\\S064\\evidence\\red\\shard-handoff.feature.snapshot');const canonicalGit=execFileSync('git',['show','HEAD:learning/S064/shard-handoff.feature']);console.log(JSON.stringify({diagnostic:'Historical raw-vs-source comparison fails on canonical LF Git source',rawSnapshotSha256:hash(snapshot),gitSourceSha256:hash(canonicalGit),snapshotCrlfPairs:(snapshot.toString('utf8').match(/\r\n/g)||[]).length},null,2));assert.equal(hash(snapshot),hash(canonicalGit),'Raw proof must remain exact, but comparisons to source must canonicalize LF');
